definition: The outward form or appearance of a person or thing.
book: The Strange Case of Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde
author: Robert Louis Stevenson
quote: I have observed that when I wore the semblance of Edward Hyde, none could come near to me at first without a visible misgiving of the flesh.
example_sentence: We tried to keep some semblance of order at the party.
